schema.text: Would cleaner, better-kept streets and squares make you feel safer when walking?

ar.#Would cleaner, better-kept streets and: هل تزيد شوارع وساحات أنظف وأفضل صيانة شعورك بالأمان أثناء المشي؟

de.#Would cleaner, better-kept streets and: Würden Sie sich zu Fuß in saubereren, besser gepflegten Straßen und Plätzen sicherer fühlen?

en.#Would cleaner, better-kept streets and: Would cleaner, better-kept streets and squares make you feel safer when walking?

fa.#Would cleaner, better-kept streets and: آیا خیابان‌ها و میدان‌های تمیزتر و بهتر نگهداری‌شده باعث می‌شود هنگام پیاده‌روی احساس امنیت بیشتری کنید؟

fr.#Would cleaner, better-kept streets and: Des rues et des places plus propres et mieux entretenues vous feraient-elles sentir plus en sécurité à pied ?

hu.#Would cleaner, better-kept streets and: Biztonságosabbnak érezné magát gyalogosan, ha tisztábbak és jobban karbantartottak lennének az utcák és a terek?

it.#Would cleaner, better-kept streets and: Strade e piazze più pulite e meglio tenute ti farebbero sentire più al sicuro a piedi?

tr.#Would cleaner, better-kept streets and: Daha temiz, daha bakımlı sokaklar ve meydanlar yürürken kendinizi daha güvende hissetmenizi sağlar mı?
